data.name: FunctionCapitalise
data.value: Capitalize each word (handles hyphenated names like "O'Brien-Smith")

data.name: ProblemNonRepeatable
data.value: The expression for '{0}' calls {1}, which returns a different value each time, so every synchronization can change the value it flows.

data.name: FlowKeepsValue
data.value: synchronization records an error and '{0}' keeps its current value

data.name: FlowFailsObject
data.value: synchronization records an error and nothing on the object is synchronized

data.name: DescribeNoValueMissingInput
data.value: Not evaluated: the object has no value for {1}, and Missing Input Behavior is Contribute no value, so '{0}' gets no value, resolved by Attribute Priority and "Null is a value".

data.name: DescribeMissingFailMapping
data.value: Not evaluated: the object has no value for {0}, and Missing Input Behavior is Fail this mapping, so {1}.

data.name: DescribeMissingFailObject
data.value: Not evaluated: the object has no value for {0}, and Missing Input Behavior is Fail the object, so {1}.

data.name: GenNothingGenerated
data.value: synchronization records an error and nothing is generated for '{0}'

data.name: DescribeBaseOnlyIfTaken
data.value: '{0}' would be generated from the base '{1}': the base itself if no other object holds it, otherwise with {2} added. Whether the base is still free is checked when a Synchronization runs.

data.name: DescribeBase
data.value: '{0}' would be generated from the base '{1}' with {2} added when a Synchronization runs.

data.name: DescribeNoBaseExpression
data.value: '{0}' has no base expression, so it would be generated from {1} alone when a Synchronization runs.
